tier_definitions.A: Code-verified: running code, passing tests, deployed artifact, or commit anchor. Claimable.
tier_definitions.B: Built and inspectable: exists and can be demonstrated, not independently verified. Describable, not claimable as proof.
tier_definitions.C: Specced / scoped / aspirational: design or scope document only. Does not execute. Never surfaced externally.
tier_definitions.UNKNOWN: No tier is stated for this framework on the codex page. Not assigned by this atlas.
